title: Channel capabilities response (CTL phase 1, capability control plane, migration 0149)
description: CTL-03's resolved capability blob: every registered capability's resolved boolean for this channel, in ONE object -- never one field fetched per capability. generation is the global registry generation this blob was resolved against; resolvedAt is when it was computed (may be earlier than the request on a cache hit). capabilities has no fixed key set -- it is a dictionary keyed by whatever capability_key values are currently registered, each already resolved through kill -> denylist -> rollout -> tier -> override (CTL-02). No key here can ever gate a durable creator record (CTL-14) and no per-tier retention value can appear (CTL-15) -- both are guarantees of the registry this blob is resolved from, not of this response shape.
